verdict.rationale: Loops' official MCP server says agents can "manage contacts and mailing lists," and the API can update contacts, so there is some first-party programmatic list management. Nothing shows list or segment creation endpoints, segment or tag APIs, or any way to read back exactly who is in a list or segment. Segments appear only as dynamic, property-driven audiences, with no documented programmatic definition. Missing for 10: documented create/update endpoints for lists, segments, or tags; an API to list members of a list or segment; tag support; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and update segments, tags, or lists programmatically and read back exactly who is in them

citations.quote: Manage contacts and mailing lists, send transactional emails, work with events, and access the rest of the Loops API.
